Title: Success Reg (Happy Path)
Steps: 1. Enter valid email/phone/name. 2. Verify OTP. 3. Set PIN.

Title: Invalid Email Format (Edge)
Expected Result: Submit button disabled validation error shown

Title: OTP Expiration (Edge)
Steps: 1. Request OTP. 2. Wait 5 mins. 3. Enter expired OTP.

Title: OTP Resend Logic
Expected Result: New OTP sent old OTP invalidated

Title: Weak Password (Edge)
Expected Result: Error: "Password must contain 8+ chars numbers symbols"

Title: Invalid Name Characters (Edge)
Expected Result: Error: "Name can only contain letters and spaces"

Title: Password Recovery
Steps: 1. Click Forgot Password. 2. Enter phone. 3. OTP Reset. 4. Set New Pass.

Title: Registration Interruption
Steps: 1. Close app during OTP step. 2. Re-open within 10 mins.
Expected Result: User returned to OTP screen to continue

Title: Linked Bank Top-up
Steps: 1. Select Linked Bank. 2. Enter $50. 3. Enter PIN.

Title: Expired Card (Edge)
Steps: 1. Enter card with expiry "01/22". 2. Check UI.

Title: Amount Below Minimum (Edge)
Expected Result: Next button disabled validation error shown

Title: Incorrect CC CVV (Edge)
Steps: 1. Enter valid card with wrong CVV. 2. Attempt top-up.

Title: Phone Transfer Success
Steps: 1. Enter recipient phone. 2. Enter $20. 3. Enter PIN.

Title: Send to Self (Edge)
Steps: 1. Enter own phone number as recipient.

Title: Zero Amount (Edge)
Expected Result: Next button disabled validation error shown

Title: Blocked Recipient (Edge)
Steps: 1. Attempt transfer to a blocked account.

Title: Suspended Sender Account (Edge)
Steps: 1. Attempt transfer from a suspended account.
